title: The interview hack that works every single time

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 75% of interviews go south because of one tiny mistake?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Right now, employers are more stressed than ever about hiring the right people.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The interview hack is asking one question that reveals everything about the candidate.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s called the “Reverse STAR” method — you ask them to describe a time you failed.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This technique helps employers spot self-awareness and growth mindset instantly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: the best candidates aren’t afraid to show their flaws.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to learn how to ask the perfect question? Follow me for the full breakdown.
